title: Identify users from the United Kingdom who own at least one post with a fav
question: Identify users from the United Kingdom who own at least one post with a favorite count of 4 or more, and who have also posted a comment on any post that has a view count between 100 and 150. Return their display names along with the title of one such highly favorited post they own.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055", T2."XCL_035"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'United Kingdom'
  AND T2."XCL_039" >= 4
  AND T1."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT T3."XCL_010"
    FROM comments AS T3
    INNER JOIN posts AS T4 ON T3."XCL_006" = T4."XCL_026"
    WHERE T4."XCL_030" BETWEEN 100 AND 150
  )
LIMIT 1
